name: stamp
label: stamp
description: Adds the time to each message.
help: Sets `msg.stampedAt` to the time as RFC 3339 in UTC, and `msg.stampedAtUnix` to the same instant in milliseconds. Needs the clock capability, which the operator grants in `plugins.grants.stamp`.

props.name: field
props.label: Property
props.help: The message property to set. The Unix milliseconds go in the same name with Unix on the end.
